key_finding: HedgeCycle aggregate root with two CycleLeg objects, hedge_ratio() via base_exposure(), is_hedge_intact() with tolerance. 13-state machine (IDENTIFIED→VALIDATED→RISK_APPROVED→ALLOCATED→LEG_A_SUBMITTED→LEG_A_PARTIAL→LEG_A_FILLED→LEG_B_SUBMITTED→LEG_B_PARTIAL→LEG_B_FILLED→HEDGED→MONITORING→EXIT_SIGNALLED→EXITING→CLOSED) plus DEGRADED, REBALANCING, UNWINDING, RECOVERING.

Multi-tick entry state machine: leg A passive with re-peg→timeout→cross; partial fill on A→size B down to match; partial fill on B→DEGRADED→rebalance (top up under-filled, fallback trim over-filled); leg B rejection→unwind A immediately. Hedging leg always crosses. Patient exit: only lead leg passive, hedge crosses on lead close. Exit timeout→cross both.

rebalance(): chooses to ADD to under-filled leg before trimming over-filled. Computes base_exposure gap, tops up via clamp_quantity. If top-up below venue minimum, trims larger leg to match smaller. Rebalance count tracked per cycle.
unwind(): close whatever is on because hedge could not be completed. Submits exit orders for both legs. Residual check: if residual<=0→UNWOUND, else→FAILED with residual exposure reported.

Exit classification: URGENT_EXITS={STOP_LOSS,RISK_LIMIT,EMERGENCY,MAX_HOLD_TIME,BASIS_DIVERGED,FUNDING_REVERSAL,MANUAL}. Patient exit only when exit_is_maker config AND reason not urgent. advance_exit(): one passive lead leg, hedge crosses immediately on lead close.

Three-way reconciliation (DB vs venue vs memory). Rule: venue is authority on positions. Mismatch classification: PHANTOM, MISSING, QUANTITY, ORPHAN, UNEXPLAINED. 'The venue holds less than I believe' means record is stale; adopt venue's number.

Delta-neutral risk: residual delta, basis risk, liquidation distance per leg, venue concentration, correlation. Worst-of escalation: NORMAL→WARNING→DANGER→EMERGENCY→KILL_SWITCH (latches, needs operator reset).

Tick loop ordering: 1) advance market data + estimators, 2) collect passive fills, 3) settle funding, 4) update open cycles, 5) evaluate risk (BEFORE entries), 6) scan opportunities, 7) allocate capital, 8) execute, 9) publish/persist. Risk evaluated before entries so breach cannot be raced.

LegPlan: one side of intended hedge priced against real depth. ProfitabilityBreakdown: itemized cost stack with validate() that checks agreement. Each CostComponent is signed (positive=credit, negative=charge).

CrossVenueExecutor: two-leg with rollback. Open forward: spot buy→futures short; on failure→sell spot back. State tracking: simulated|filled|rolled_back|naked|aborted. Naked triggers alert for manual handling. MAX_VENUE_PRICE_SPREAD_PCT=1.0 gate before entry.

Pure futures cross-venue executor: perp+perp spread. Parallel leg submission via ThreadPoolExecutor. Position ledger in JSON (scripts/data/pure-futures/positions.json). _floor_qty() for lot-size compliance, _filled() tracking. MAX_MARK_PRICE_SPREAD_PCT=1.0 gate.

Funding-period mismatch: normalizes rates to common time window, calculates max cumulative outflow, generates adjusted net_edge accounting for cash flow asymmetry. MismatchAnalysis dataclass with long/short rate per 8h, spread per 8h, max cumulative outflow pct.
Working Lighter venue adapter. Verified against mainnet (verify_lighter_live.py exists). Part of multi-venue framework covering Binance, Bybit, OKX, Hyperliquid, dYdX, EdgeX, Aster, Lighter.

ArbitrageExecutor: control_task polls both venue prices, normalizes via RateOracle (quote asset conversion), fires market orders on both legs simultaneously when profitable. Tracks buy_order and sell_order as TrackedOrder. check_order_status: both filled→COMPLETED. No partial fill handling, no post-only.
ArbitrageExecutorConfig: buying_market + selling_market as ConnectorPair, order_amount, min_profitability. Validated: require_interchangeable_pairs ensures both markets trade same underlying asset.

31k★ Rust-native event-driven engine. No multi-venue two-leg spread/arbitrage strategy example found. Has OMS, position netting, order emulator, OKX/Hyperliquid/Bybit adapters. Infrastructure exists for building a two-leg basis strategy but no ready pattern to copy.
